policy: External sources were selected before any entrywise model ranking because no such ranking exists. They define validation standards and annotate the pre-existing TLS positive-control family; they are not claimed as validation of the current models.

sources.title: Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
sources.authors: Adebayo J, Gilmer J, Muelly M, Goodfellow I, Hardt M, Kim B
sources.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 31
sources.supports: Model- and data-randomization checks are necessary before treating a saliency or gradient readout as learned-model evidence.

sources.title: Integrated intra- and intercellular signaling knowledge for multicellular omics analysis
sources.supports: OmniPath integrates literature-curated intra- and intercellular signaling knowledge and preserves direction and sign where available; it is suitable as an annotation/reference source, not experimental proof in this core.

sources.title: CellPhoneDB: inferring cell-cell communication from combined expression of multi-subunit ligand-receptor complexes
sources.authors: Efremova M, Vento-Tormo M, Teichmann SA, Vento-Tormo R et al.
sources.supports: Curated ligand-receptor complexes can annotate candidate communication families, including multimeric complexes; expression-based inference remains predicted communication rather than direct mechanistic verification.

sources.title: Differing activities of homeostatic chemokines CCL19, CCL21, and CXCL12 in lymphocyte and dendritic cell recruitment and lymphoid neogenesis
sources.supports: Ectopic chemokine-expression experiments established recruitment and lymphoid-neogenesis activity for the CCL19/CCL21 family, supporting its use as a biological positive-control family.

sources.title: Cooperating mechanisms of CXCR5 and CCR7 in development and organization of secondary lymphoid organs
sources.supports: Double-deficiency experiments support cooperative roles for the CXCL13-CXCR5 and CCL19/CCL21-CCR7 axes in lymphoid organ development and organization.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence and Multimodality Data Integration Decipher Tertiary Lymphoid Structure Maturity in Gastric Cancer
sources.supports: Single-cell data from 17 gastric-cancer patients combined with multiplex IHC, flow cytometry, and functional coculture assays supported a CXCL13-CXCR5 immune circuit in mature gastric TLSs.

sources.title: High-plex imaging of RNA and proteins at subcellular resolution in fixed tissue by spatial molecular imaging
sources.supports: Establishes the CosMx spatial molecular imaging measurement platform; it does not validate model-implied interactions in this dataset.
